about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Mike Kennedy

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE EMERGENCY CLAIMS PARITY ACT
statements.title: INDIAN HEALTH SERVICE EMERGENCY CLAIMS PARITY ACT
sentences: That experience is why I rise today in support of my bill, H.R. 8658, the Indian Health Service Emergency Claims Parity Act.
Today, when an American Indian or Alaska Native patient receives emergency care outside the Indian Health Service, the IHS must be notified within 72 hours.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 8658.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING DOMESTIC MINING ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTING DOMESTIC MINING ACT OF 2025
sentences: I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SALUTING LITTLE LEAGUE SOFTBALL WORLD SERIES
statements.title: SALUTING LITTLE LEAGUE SOFTBALL WORLD SERIES
sentences: Nowhere is that principle more clearly demonstrated than in the tangible benefits that Americans are already seeing through the working families tax cuts.

When we passed that landmark legislation, we made simple promises to the American people: They should keep more of what they earn, and we, Congress, would rein in Federal overreach, eliminate wasteful spending, and return resources to the people who worked to earn them.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IT IS TIME FOR CONGRESS TO ACT
statements.title: IT IS TIME FOR CONGRESS TO ACT
sentences: We have all witnessed the harms caused by an unchecked social media algorithm: anxiety and depression, lost sleep, and even a lost childhood.
It does not cover the next algorithm.
That is what my Algorithm Accountability Act does.

It strips section 230 immunity from platforms that violate a clear duty of care to their users, and it gives families, not just State attorneys general, the ability to hold these companies accountable in Federal court.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICANS LEAVE A TREMENDOUS LEGACY
statements.title: AMERICANS LEAVE A TREMENDOUS LEGACY
sentences: They preserved the old craftsmanship, and they made it strong enough to stand for generations we will never meet.
We did the hard and unseen work to make it last, and we will pass it on stronger than we found it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING SANCTITY OF LIFE
statements.title: PROTECTING SANCTITY OF LIFE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, 4 years ago this week, the Supreme Court ruled in Dobbs that the Constitution contains no right to an abortion.
Firsthand, I have seen the heartbeat of an infant on an ultrasound.
Because of the Dobbs decision, the States and all of us are made free to uphold our duty and protect the sanctity of life.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO FUNDS FOR REPEAT CHILD CARE VIOLATIONS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NO FUNDS FOR REPEAT CHILD CARE VIOLATIONS ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 7726, the Stop Child Care Scams Act of 2026.
Before I came to Congress, I spent my career as a physician in Utah caring for working families.
While our Federal childcare programs serve a useful purpose, they are being systematically ruined by rampant fraud.
As the sponsor of the Stop Child Care Funding Fraud Act, I am glad to see similar policies reflected in this bill.
Rooting out waste, fraud, and abuse should be every Member's priority for these people in this Chamber, and I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LICENSE TO DRILL ACT
statements.title: LICENSE TO DRILL ACT
sentences: We must take practical steps to meet demand because meeting demand is how we keep energy affordable for working families.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my legislation, the License to Drill Act.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GEOTHERMAL ENERGY ADVANCEMENT ACT
statements.title: GEOTHERMAL ENERGY ADVANCEMENT ACT
sentences: It is firm, baseload power, the kind that can keep the grid stable and energy affordable for working families.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 5631, the Geothermal Energy Advancement Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STAR-SPANGLED SUMMIT ACT OF 2026
statements.title: STAR-SPANGLED SUMMIT ACT OF 2026
sentences: That is why I introduced the Star-Spangled Summit Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to join me in supporting H.R. 4684, the Star-Spangled Summit Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIRE IMPROVEMENT AND REFORMING EXCEPTIONAL EVENTS ACT
statements.title: FIRE IMPROVEMENT AND REFORMING EXCEPTIONAL EVENTS ACT
sentences: I urge my colleagues to vote in favor of the FIRE Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7744, FURTHER ADDITIONAL CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7744, FURTHER ADDITIONAL CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Even more troubling is the fact that the agency tasked with keeping Americans safe from terrorism is defunded when we face terrorist threats from Iran.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the rule to put a stop to yet another Democrat/Schumer shutdown and fund the Department of Homeland Security at this critical time.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PRESIDENT WASHINGTON'S FAREWELL ADDRESS
statements.title: PRESIDENT WASHINGTON'S FAREWELL ADDRESS
sentences: ``In looking forward to the moment which is intended to terminate the career of my public life, my feelings do not permit me to suspend the deep acknowledgment of that debt of gratitude which I owe to my beloved country for the many honors it has conferred upon me; still more for the steadfast confidence with which it has supported me; and for the opportunities I have thence enjoyed of manifesting my inviolable attachment, by services faithful and persevering, though in usefulness unequal to my zeal.

One method of preserving it is to use it as sparingly as possible, avoiding occasions of expense by cultivating peace, but remembering also that timely disbursements to prepare for danger frequently prevent much greater disbursements to repel it; avoiding likewise the accumulation of debt, not only by shunning occasions of expense, but by vigorous exertions in time of peace to discharge the debts which unavoidable wars may have occasioned, not ungenerously throwing upon posterity the burden which we ourselves ought to bear.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF S. 1383, VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2189, LAW- ENFORCEMENT INNOVATE T
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF S. 1383, VETERANS ACCESSIBILITY ADVISORY COMMITTEE ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2189, LAW- ENFORCEMENT INNOVATE TO DE-ESCALATE ACT; PROVIDING FOR...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to stand in support of the SAVE America Act.
The SAVE America Act is guided by one simple principle: Only Americans should decide American elections.
Across this country, we have seen noncitizens identified on voter rolls.
Let us pass the SAVE America Act to keep our elections exclusively in the hands of the American people.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to join me.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LOWERING HOUSING COSTS AND ADVANCING MAIN STREET COMMUNITY BANKS
statements.title: LOWERING HOUSING COSTS AND ADVANCING MAIN STREET COMMUNITY BANKS
sentences: This individual has taken out enormous amounts of debt to achieve that significant opportunity to become a doctor and currently is in that practice.
When added to the medical school debt, this individual in their early thirties is subject to a million dollars of debt.
I thank Chairman French Hill for his leadership in confronting the housing affordability crisis with practical and progrowth reforms.

Between the red tape of regulatory delays and the rigid constraints of zoning, the path to affordable living is being made more difficult to navigate, and it is American families who are paying the price.
It encourages zoning reform the right way.
It respects local control and gives communities tools and flexibility to expand housing supply, rather than forcing one-size-fits-all mandates from Washington.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Housing for the 21st Century Act.
I support this because it is good policy, and I support it because my constituents want me to support this.
But I also support it because my children and grandchildren deserve better than what we are currently delivering.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EPIDEMIC OF WASTE, FRAUD, AND ABUSE
statements.title: EPIDEMIC OF WASTE, FRAUD, AND ABUSE
sentences: We just found out about a case in my own district where an individual was collecting her dead mother's Social Security checks for 3 years.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to the epidemic of waste, fraud, and abuse that is ripping off taxpayers with impunity.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: As a family practice doctor for more than 25 years, I hear directly from my patients about the skyrocketing cost of insurance and prescription drugs.
Healthcare costs have skyrocketed since ObamaCare went into effect.
The ACA promised to lower healthcare premiums by up to $2,500 per family per year, but since ObamaCare went into effect, premiums have nearly tripled and deductibles have nearly doubled.
The benchmark ACA silver plan cost $346 a month in 2014.
The benchmark ACA silver plan deductible was $2,425 in 2014.
A 2024 GAO investigation found that fake identities were approved for ObamaCare subsidies at a 100 percent rate.
Often remaining enrolled despite missing or falsified documentation, these ObamaCare subsidies continued for these fraudulent applications.

Taxpayers are left footing the bill as reused Social Security numbers, subsidies paid on behalf of deceased individuals, and billions in unreconciled payments expose a system unable to protect public funds.
To be clear, expanding access to health insurance and protecting people with preexisting conditions are worthy goals, but good intentions do not excuse bad results.
Their answer has been more taxpayer subsidies to paper over ObamaCare's problems.
I am not going to vote to promote a broken ObamaCare system.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING HEALTHCARE FOR MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
statements.title: PROTECTING HEALTHCARE FOR MILLIONS OF AMERICANS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I will point out the last thing about Doug is that he loved his country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PET AND LIVESTOCK PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: PET AND LIVESTOCK PROTECTION ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the Do No Harm in Medicaid Act, which will ensure that taxpayer dollars are not funding the evil practice of transgender child mutilation.
That is why, as a Utah State senator, I led the way in 2023 by passing Utah's landmark legislation that banned transgender treatments and procedures for minors.

When it comes to gender-transition interventions, puberty blockers, hormones like testosterone and estrogen, and surgical procedures, the evidence shows that this is the wrong approach to getting these kids the help that they need.

There is no strong, long-term evidence showing that puberty blockers and transgender surgeries improve long-term mental or physical health outcomes for minors, nor is there robust data on their safety or impact on development.

In the United States, the Department of Health and Human Services released a peer-reviewed report last month titled: ``Treatment for Pediatric Gender Dysphoria: Review of Evidence and Best Practices.'' This study concluded that harms from treatments, including these puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones, and surgeries are significant, long-term, and frequently underrecognized in clinical research.
I urge all of my colleagues to follow the scientific evidence and stop funding these horrific procedures on kids.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REPUBLICANS HAVE DELIVERED IN 2025
statements.title: REPUBLICANS HAVE DELIVERED IN 2025
sentences: We have taken action and are committed to doing more to fix the broken system of ObamaCare that empowered Big Insurance at the expense of our taxpayers.
As a family practice doctor for over 25 years, I hear directly from my patients about the skyrocketing cost of insurance and prescription drugs.

Former President Obama, in pushing the ACA, promised that the bill would lower healthcare premiums by up to $2,500 per family per year, but since ObamaCare went into effect, premiums have nearly tripled and deductibles have more than doubled.
Back in July of this year, this Republican Congress passed the Working Families Tax Cut Act.
This important legislation puts more money back into the pockets of Americans and will help lower the cost of healthcare as well as childcare.
Thanks to the Working Families Tax Cut Act, all Bronze and Catastrophic ACA Marketplace plans are now considered high-deductible plans, allowing more people to contribute to health savings accounts.
High costs are not the only ObamaCare failure.
A 2024 GAO investigation found that fake identities were approved for ObamaCare subsidies at a 100 percent rate, often remaining enrolled despite missing or falsified information.

Taxpayers were left footing the bill, as reused Social Security numbers, subsidies paid on behalf of deceased individuals, and billions in unreconciled payments expose a system unable to protect public funds.

In the Working Families Tax Cut Act, Republicans restored accountability and fairness to the healthcare marketplace through reforms that save taxpayers billions of dollars and drive down costs for everyone.
We have ended ``anytime'' enrollment abuse that fueled fraudulent signups and drove premiums higher for everyone.
We closed loopholes that allowed illegal immigrants and other ineligible groups to access taxpayer-funded health benefits.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UTAH WILDFIRE RESEARCH INSTITUTE ACT OF 2025
statements.title: UTAH WILDFIRE RESEARCH INSTITUTE ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my bill, H.R. 1045, the Utah Wildfire Research Institute Act of 2025.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the Utah Wildfire Research Institute Act as this investment will protect Utah for generations to come.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 5371, CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H. RES. 719, HONORING THE LIFE AND LEGA
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 5371, CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H. RES. 719, HONORING THE LIFE AND LEGACY OF CHARLES "CHARLIE" JAMES...
sentences: Instead, generation after generation, we have chosen the harder path: to keep the conversation going and to answer speech we oppose with more speech and with reason, civility, and conviction, rather than be intimidated by violence or dragged down into vengeance.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP ILLEGAL ENTRY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: STOP ILLEGAL ENTRY ACT OF 2025
sentences: For too long, open-border policies have left American families at risk.
Madam Speaker, I rise today in strong support of Representative Bice's Stop Illegal Entry Act of 2025, and I applaud my colleague, Mr. Knott, for his role in this important piece of legislation.
I urge my colleagues to support this commonsense legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PERSONNEL OVERSIGHT AND SHIFT TRACKING ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PERSONNEL OVERSIGHT AND SHIFT TRACKING ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my bill, H.R. 3425, the Personnel Oversight and Shift Tracking Act of 2025, or the POST Act.

Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 3425, the POST Act, so that we restore proper oversight and accountability in the Federal Protective Service and protect taxpayers from waste and failure.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMISES MADE, PROMISES KEPT
statements.title: PROMISES MADE, PROMISES KEPT
sentences: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act also protects about 72,000 full-time jobs in Utah over the next 4 years relative to if the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act had been allowed to expire.
Northrop manufactures the five-segment solid rocket boosters for NASA's Space Launch System in Utah.
They are currently developing next- generation rocket boosters, which will power us to the Moon and Mars.
Thanks to the passage of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, NASA will receive $4.1 billion for the Space Launch System for the Artemis IV and V missions.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BENEFITS OF ONE BIG, BEAUTIFUL BILL
statements.title: BENEFITS OF ONE BIG, BEAUTIFUL BILL
sentences: This legislation ensures that nearly 90 percent of Social Security beneficiaries will no longer pay Federal income taxes on their benefits.
In Utah alone, around 400,000 seniors could benefit from the no taxes on Social Security provision of this bill.

Under this bill, the budget will provide for restoration and renovation of barracks, more funding for the Defense Health Program, aid to military families by adding to the childcare fee assistance, and bonuses for members of the military.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4016, DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3633, DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 4016, DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3633, DIGITAL ASSET MARKET CLARITY ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the rule for H.R. 3633, the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025 and H.R. 1919, the Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act.
Together, these bills provide much needed clarity on digital asset regulation and ensure critical consumer protections so Americans retain their financial freedom.
The same is true for digital assets.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: As a provider of healthcare myself, as a doctor, and as a recipient of Medicaid services--my first three children were born on Medicaid--in addition to the fact that as a child, I was receiving food assistance not only from free school lunch programs but church programs, recognizing the vital need associated with Medicaid as well as with these food programs, we need to rightsize these programs.
The reality behind this is, this bill that we are discussing today is insisting on work requirements associated with the recipients of Medicaid.
If you are an able-bodied, working adult, you should be able to go out and find a job.
If you can't find a job, you need to go to a training program and try to find training so that you can get a job and ultimately get off Medicaid.
One of the components about Medicaid, we all know, is that it was formed in favor of pregnant women, disabled people, as well as the elderly.
What the Republicans are trying to do is rightsize the Medicaid program so that it survives for the long-term, vital needs of the people of the future.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as a family physician, I have seen both the benefits and issues associated with Medicaid.
Currently there are 7.6 million people on Medicaid who should not be there.
Mr. Speaker, there are 1.4 million illegal immigrants, 1.2 million who are ineligible for Medicaid, and 4.8 million able-bodied adults who choose not to work.
As we assess the state of Medicaid, we find that roughly $1 in every $4 are spent improperly with more than 80 percent of these payments stemming from eligibility errors.
Medicaid is critically important for countless Americans, and this bill will ensure that those who truly need it can continue to access the care they depend on.
Medicaid was designed to support the disabled, pregnant women, children, and those who are in need.
It has ballooned with able-bodied adults who are currently not required to be working.
Mr. Speaker, Republicans are trying to fix Medicaid and preserve it for those who need it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OUTRAGEOUS GOVERNMENT-FUNDED INCENTIVES
statements.title: OUTRAGEOUS GOVERNMENT-FUNDED INCENTIVES
sentences: We have lived through the most devastating border crisis in modern American history.
During their time in office, President Biden and Vice President Harris dismantled nearly every meaningful safeguard at the southern border.
Their administration presided over a record surge in illegal immigration, over 700,000 illegal aliens were apprehended at the border from October through December of 2023 alone.
That was more than any full year during the Obama Presidency when President Obama famously stated that over 1,000 illegal border crossings a day would be considered a crisis.

Rather than empower border enforcement, the Biden-Harris administration threw open the Federal checkbook, funneling billions of taxpayer dollars to private nonprofits like Family Endeavors Incorporated, Southwest Key Programs, and Global Refuge.
These NGOs didn't just shelter illegal aliens.
In 2022, a mere $56 million was spent on housing maintenance for military families, less than one-twentieth of what was spent for illegal aliens.
The Biden-Harris administration relaxed vetting standards for those who claimed to sponsor alien children.
DNA testing was scrapped, and background checks were watered down.
While our southern border is certainly more secure now, we have hundreds of thousands of illegal alien cases that will overwhelm our legal system for years.
We must defund corrupt NGOs, restore vetting and enforcement, and put the American people first again.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNITED STATES RESEARCH PROTECTION ACT
statements.title: UNITED STATES RESEARCH PROTECTION ACT
sentences: Everyone in this Chamber knows the growing threat from the Chinese Communist Party.
This adversary has made no secret of its intentions to surpass the United States in key technological areas, from artificial intelligence to quantum computing to biotechnology.
In 2022, Congress passed the Research and Development, Competition, and Innovation Act as part of the CHIPS and Science Act.

The Science, Space, and Technology Committee has been conducting vigorous oversight of the implementation of the CHIPS Act and has found that complicated and confusing language in the bill was impeding the ability of American researchers and their institutions to protect taxpayer-funded research.

This ambiguity could also allow for loopholes, allowing malign foreign talent recruitment programs in our universities and other research labs to recruit researchers or access sensitive data, effectively funding breakthrough research for the Chinese Communist Party with American taxpayers' dollars.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today to support the passage of my legislation, the United States Research Protection Act.
We are telling them we will not stand idly by as American innovations are put at risk.
We are telling the world that the United States will continue to lead in the global technological race, and we will do so on our terms.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SPACE DOMINANCE
statements.title: SPACE DOMINANCE
sentences: I am excited to join him as a new member on the subcommittee and highlight Utah's exciting role in the future of space exploration.
We stand at the crossroads of an exciting new era in space exploration.
I want to highlight one of the most pivotal players in Utah's contribution to space exploration, Northrop Grumman, which has more than an 80-year history in the State.

These boosters are key to propelling spacecraft, like NASA's Space Launch System, which is set to carry astronauts deeper into space than ever before, including the planned missions to the Moon under the Artemis program and eventually to Mars.

Northrop Grumman's advancements in propulsion have opened up incredible possibilities for deep-space exploration, including human missions to the Moon and Mars, asteroid mining, and future scientific discoveries beyond our current cognitive capabilities.
Utah universities have also been big contributors to the NASA- sponsored BIG Idea Challenge to power the Artemis program forward.

In 2023, we had a BIG Idea team from the University of Utah that won first place overall as the Artemis Award Winner with their development of the ``Production of Steel from Lunar Regolith through Carbonyl Iron Refining'' project.
As we look toward the stars and the limitless possibilities of the cosmos, it is clear that Utah's contribution to space exploration will be integral.

From Northrop Grumman's groundbreaking solid rocket boosters to the innovation happening across our State, Utah is not only playing a role in the future of space exploration, but it is helping to define it.
I greatly look forward to working with him to make sure NASA is in a position to return to the Moon and take the next step of planting the Stars and Stripes on Mars.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING THE CONSTITUTION AGAINST ALL ENEMIES, FOREIGN AND DOMESTIC
statements.title: DEFENDING THE CONSTITUTION AGAINST ALL ENEMIES, FOREIGN AND DOMESTIC
sentences: As a legislator, I intend to honor the promises I made to my constituents when I asked for their votes: to take seriously the problems we confront, which include a porous border and a massive national debt.
I will be a foe to those who would work to turn the people over to the government and a friend to those who will turn the government over to the people.
